limits: This replays four hundred thirty eight bounded C source/data stages after the corrected Main archive; 188 imports remain; the dominant-hand handler and all six descendants exposed by its parent are C-bound. Cordio connection action and interface tables, the 80-byte five-state/eight-event matrix and state-machine executor, no-op/close/closed/failed/opened/HCI-updated leaves, empty handlers, message/HCI handlers, secondary message and HCI handlers, all eight secondary HCI callback actions, reset/defaults, special-state and address CCB lookups, CCB allocation/deallocation, HCI connection commands and scan-stop command, three-slot connection count, five-slot callback fanout, CTE and privacy event forwarding, out-of-range update action lookup, invalid-set diagnostic, and update entry trace are C-bound under controlled comparisons. The eight-slot DM dispatch table at 0x78a880 is source-owned, with the stack interface alias at slot three; its message dispatcher forwards the message pointer. All eight DM dispatch table entries have C bodies: security HCI dispatch 0x4d2364, scan-start 0x536820, the 0x4d2544 forwarder to SmpDbInit at 0x542288, reset 0x536918, and HCI dispatch 0x53694c with scan-complete child 0x5368b6 are C-bound. The security dispatch, its exposed LTK, LESC, SMP indication and STK children, and three-slot security, PHY, LESC, privacy AES and primary privacy interfaces with message/HCI handlers are C-bound. All six newly exposed privacy HCI/DM child calls have C bodies, while native logging branches of the device-privacy forwarder remain open. The legacy advertising reset, message and HCI handlers, eight message actions, configuration child, address-mode conversion, LE parameter command and three data/enable HCI commands are C-bound; the three-slot advertising interface, synthetic directed connection-completion record and dynamic downstream connection callback dispatch are source-owned. All nonempty connection interface handlers in the three Cordio records are C-bound. The DM CCB and callback registry share a 196-byte C-owned block covering the reset's highest observed write; the old 144-byte weak BSS remains in the overlay and final RAM placement is open. The advertising control overlay rebinds 24 relocations to 0x34 bytes of C storage covering the duration and two-handle peer completion fields through +0x32; the archived 0x20 bytes remain orphaned and final RAM placement is open. The two persistent record names share one 2560-byte NOLOAD MRAM reservation, and the OTA flag has a 16-byte NOLOAD reservation at 0x007fe000; final Main linker integration remains open. The ALS sync callback, settings byte setter and ROM display-context getter are C-bound across five logging masks. The six-word display manager interface and five asynchronous queue callbacks are C-owned with 60 native queue/log comparisons. The tracepoint registry callback and role helper are C-owned with 160 native comparisons; its BLE-data child is C-bound across 280 native cases; the slave-list child, request-file-name handler, and file-system deletion children remain exposed imports; the nanopb descriptor and single-file handler are C-bound. The 0x206-byte tracepoint decode clear span has a bounded C-owned NOLOAD reservation; full allocation extent and final RAM layout remain open. The tracepoint delete-all handler and result constructor are C-bound for 90 native cases, with a separate 0x206-byte NOLOAD reply reservation at 0x2037bbc8; reply routing is C-bound for 240 native/C cases; both reply transport children are C-bound for 540 cases, the response encoder and bounded 0x300-byte TX buffer are C-bound, and the four-node nanopb descriptor graph is source-owned; the single-file deletion handler is C-bound for 120 native cases and exposes validator/storage children; the pathname prefix resolver is C-bound for 48 native cases its numeric parser is C-bound for 45 filename cases, its validator is C-bound for 264 cases, its bounded path formatter is C-bound for 25 cases, the active-file close/clear path is C-bound with a four-byte NOLOAD handle slot, the unlink facade is C-bound for 72 native cases with a four-byte readiness cell, errno location is C-bound, and the public LittleFS remove wrapper is C-bound; the LittleFS remove core is C-bound for 40 native cases and its directory drop child is C-bound for eight native cases; the tracepoint sorted file inventory is C-bound for 50 cases with a 0x88-byte NOLOAD span; the request handler and formatter are C-bound for 64 cases each, the scan for 32 cases and file size for 30 cases, with reset and directory API children C-bound; pull initialization is C-bound for 36 native cases and pull readiness is C-bound for 256 controlled native cases; tracepoint file open, stream sync and write, the LittleFS mkdir core, and tracepoint delete-all traversal now have C bodies; pull completion is C-bound for five controlled cases, batch write for 144, pending reopen for eight, pull-path formatting for sixteen, new-file creation for 144, TPF1 header/endian/CRC for 42, version packing for nine, four-file retention for 21, directory inventory for fourteen, filename parsing for sixteen, TPS1 state writing for 54, backend initialization for 216, file sizing for 32, TPS1 recovery for 60, and guarded mkdir for 60. The privacy event status byte is unwritten. Calibration RAM startup values, page build and callback, live image decoder, display dispatch, final stock placement and hardware behavior remain open. The Nema encoder has 2420 native comparisons.
Native RAM initializers, full-image layout and hardware behavior remain open.
